worst_moment: "You said the oxygens balance, but H2O2 is not water. Try again with H2O." - tells a student who has just written the correct balanced equation that they are still wrong.
best_moment: "Putting the 2 in front of H2O means two water molecules, so you get two oxygens. Try that and count the atoms again." - clearly explains coefficient versus subscript and hands it back.
